description: This file is a Jupyter Notebook (.ipynb) containing Python code for creating a model trainer component, including configuration management, data loading, training an ElasticNet model, and saving the trained model.

classes.name: ModelTrainerConfig
classes.description: Dataclass holding configuration parameters for model training, including paths, model name, and hyperparameters.

classes.name: ConfigurationManager
classes.description: Class responsible for loading configuration, parameters, and schema YAML files, and providing model trainer configuration.

classes.name: ModelTrainer
classes.description: Class that handles training an ElasticNet model using provided configuration, and saving the trained model.

methods.name: get_model_trainer_config
methods.description: Method in ConfigurationManager that constructs and returns a ModelTrainerConfig object based on loaded YAML files.

methods.name: train
methods.description: Method in ModelTrainer that loads training and testing data, trains an ElasticNet model, and saves it.
